elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance on expiry or termination
elements.evidence: Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, TrueLink shall (a) ... provide reasonable transition assistance

elements.element: Transition assistance available for up to 6 months
Return of Customer Data within 30 days of expiry or termination
elements.evidence: within thirty (30) days of Client's request, return to Client all Client Content and other Client data

elements.element: Return in a standard machine-readable format
elements.evidence: in a commonly used, machine-readable format

elements.element: Deletion of Customer Data after return
elements.evidence: (c) thereafter delete such Client Content and data from its systems
certify such deletion to Client in writing
for up to six (6) months at TrueLink's then-current rates
within thirty (30) days of Client's request

reasons: The 30-day data-return deadline runs from 'Client's request' rather than from expiration or termination, so a request condition swallows the mandatory post-termination return; the preferred position requires return within 30 days of expiry or termination.
Because the return clock is request-triggered rather than termination-triggered, the fallback's 'data export within 30 days' is also not squarely met.
Fix is narrow: change '(b) within thirty (30) days of Client's request' to '(b) within thirty (30) days of such expiration or termination'.

All other preferred elements are present: up to six months' assistance at then-current rates, machine-readable ('commonly used, machine-readable') format, deletion thereafter, and written certification of deletion.
The insertion is a concise new clause for an absent obligation and leaves the term, non-renewal, ownership and termination mechanics untouched.
